## 1. Statutory Provision Details
- **Governing Act**: (e.g. Income-tax Act, 1961 / Companies Act, 2013 / CGST Act, 2017)
- **Section / Rule Number**: (e.g. Section 194C / Section 188 / Rule 89(5))
- **Applicable Regulatory Domain**: [ ] Direct Tax  [ ] Indirect Tax (GST)  [ ] MSME  [ ] Corporate Governance (MCA)  [ ] Financial Reporting (Ind AS)  [ ] Other

## 2. Official Primary Citations
- **Union Gazette / Ministry Notification Link**: (Must be an official government URL, e.g. incometaxindia.gov.in, cbic.gov.in, rbi.org.in, mca.gov.in)
- **Relevant Executive Circulars**: (e.g. Circular No. XX of 202X)

## 3. Operational Invariants & Thresholds
- **Threshold Limit**: (e.g. ₹30,000 single bill / ₹1,00,000 aggregate)
- **Statutory Deduction / Collection Rate**: (e.g. 1% individual / 2% company)
- **Non-PAN / Penal Rate**: (e.g. 20% under Section 206AA)

## 4. Temporal Enforcement
- **Effective From Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Sunset Date (if applicable)**: YYYY-MM-DD or OPEN_ENDED
